Flagship Project 01 • Full-Stack Digital Commerce Deployed • 76 Automated Tests Passing
GameVault — Digital Game Subscriptions & Gift Cards Marketplace
React 18 • Node.js • Express.js • MySQL • Sequelize ORM • Stripe Checkout • Vercel Serverless
🔗 Live Storefront 📦 GitHub Repo

System Overview: GameVault is a production-deployed digital gaming marketplace featuring 37 verified products across 15 game subscriptions (Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, Nintendo Switch Online, EA Play), 8 digital gift cards, and 14 digital games. Engineered with an interactive sliding cart drawer, real-time promo discount math (GAMER10), server-authoritative pricing, cryptographic Stripe webhook verification, and a staff fulfillment queue.

76/76 Automated Tests
37 Products Live
Zero Client Price Tampering
< 2.4s Production Build

Core Architectural Innovations:

  • Server-Authoritative Price Validation: Protects against browser client tampering. Cart items, quantities, and discounts are recomputed server-side from MySQL records before initiating Stripe Checkout sessions.
  • Interactive Sliding Cart Drawer: Features quantity clamps (1..5), instant subtotal updates, dynamic promo code evaluation, and seamless outside-click dismissal.
  • Cryptographic Stripe Webhook Pipeline: Signature-verified webhook processing with an idempotent ledger table preventing duplicate order fulfillments on Stripe event replays.
  • Staff 1-Hour Manual Fulfillment Queue: Dedicated operations queue for email delivery of digital codes, tracking customer contacts, regional variants, and completion timestamps.
  • Edge Serverless Functions: Deployed high-throughput Vercel edge endpoints (/api/checkout/sessions, /api/promos/validate, /api/health).
Figure 1.1: Live GameVault storefront on Vercel displaying verified subscription services, direct brand-tile routing, and curated deals.
Security & Concurrency Safeguards:

• Strict anti-tampering guards reject live checkout creation for unstocked or demo listings.
• 56 backend tests verify SQL transactions, token expiration, and CSRF defense headers.
• 20 frontend tests verify promo code calculations, cart bounds, and route deduplication.

End-to-End System Architecture & Transaction Lifecycle:
Client UI (React 18 + Cart Drawer) → Vercel Serverless (/api/checkout) → Stripe Hosted Checkout → Signed Webhook (Idempotent Ledger) → Staff Fulfillment Queue

Core Architectural Innovations:

  • Hands-Free Web Speech API Voice Dictation: Captures developer intent naturally on mobile, appending dictated instructions without overwriting drafts or triggering keyboard auto-zoom.
  • Automated Multi-Key Rotation Pool: Automatically detects HTTP 429 rate limits across pooled Google Gemini accounts, switching active keys instantly with live quota tracking.
  • Self-Healing Autonomous Test Loops: Dispatches code generation into isolated sandboxes, executing npm test and npm run build repeatedly until exit code 0 is achieved.
  • Cloud Browser Engine & Session Vault: Hardened serverless proxy with SSRF protection blocking loopback (127.0.0.1) and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) IPs.
  • Laptop-Offline Cloud Dispatch: Dispatches mobile-initiated issues directly to cloud runners even when developer workstations are powered off.

Predictive Analytics & Forecasting Module • Grade: A • Tooling: KNIME Analytics & SAS Viya
Module Grade: A

End-to-end predictive modeling project comparing linear and ensemble machine learning algorithms to predict caloric expenditure during cardiovascular and resistance training workouts.

  • Data Cleansing: Ingested 4,865 raw records; cleansed outliers and invalid heart-rate readings to produce 950 validated records.
  • Feature Engineering: Constructed interaction variables between Workout Intensity, Mean Heart Rate, and Session Duration.

  • Model Selection: Gradient Boosting delivered superior predictive accuracy (lowest RMSE and highest R²), with Session Duration as the dominant driver.
